evaluation_method: Deterministic replay of the v0.4 decision logic against the branch JSON fixtures during the implementation session; this is not a GitHub Actions or production-runtime test.

limitations: Only claims with routing metadata can make an explicit claim-level routing decision in v0.4.
Verified claims without routing metadata still use the existing issue-level intent-signature fallback.
Similarity ranking is used only to propose claim candidates; similarity alone does not make a question answerable.
No RAG or free-form answer generation is evaluated.
